{{Top|leg}}
'''Duma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He attempted to rally the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to ambush the Empire's top [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Attack on Duma's forces|preemptive strike]] by the Empire.
